reading.format: It is a 16-course series delivered online on Coursera. It includes hands-on labs, projects, and a guided project to build a real-world generative AI application.
reading.summary: This is a 16-course professional certificate from IBM on Coursera. It teaches generative AI engineering, including large language models, natural language processing, and Python-based application development. Completing it shows skills in building and deploying generative AI applications, agents, and chatbots.
reading.audience: The page says it is for aspiring generative AI engineers, AI developers, data scientists, machine learning engineers, and AI research engineers. It is beginner level and requires no prior experience.
